source='''def transform(grid):
    # The uniform nonzero row separates two same-sized masks.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if row and row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row))
    top = grid[:split]
    bottom = grid[split + 1:]
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(grid[0]))]
            for r in range(len(top))]
